scope: Six fixed synthetic development probes, once per arm and policy; planning only.

protocol_details.request_counting: One shared lock-protected reservation before each chat or embedding SDK request; requests rejected beyond 40.
protocol_details.order: on_demand then parallel; each runs rules_llm, rules_classifier_llm, rules_classifier_embedding_llm in fixed case order.
protocol_details.timing: Single sequential run per arm; includes cold business embedding index and network variation; excludes classifier warmup. Not end-to-end response latency.
protocol_details.scoring: Validated plans are checked for the expected action set, annotated argument subset and forbidden actions. No answer generation or hospital tools.
protocol_details.isolation: Current source snapshot in a new container temporary directory; existing classifier mounted read-only; temporary evaluation budgets; no service restart or deployment.
protocol_details.candidate_control: Character-neighbour candidates removed in all arms to isolate classifier and embedding additions.
protocol_details.local_control: The canonical case uses deterministic parsing and zero provider requests in every arm.

parallel.interpretation: Six selected annotated cases, one run per arm. Canonical case is a local control. Character candidates removed equally. No tools executed. Cold embedding index cost included; classifier warmup excluded. Not a representative accuracy estimate or proof of improvement.

interpretation: With classifier and embedding configured, both policies passed all six development probes in this run. On-demand used two embedding requests (one cold example-bank batch and one query), versus six for parallel (one bank batch and five queries). Both used five Planner requests.
The rules_llm baseline passed 6/6 in the first run and 5/6 in the second. Policies do not change the candidate-free baseline; this variation is not evidence of a policy effect.

The failed second-baseline history probe recorded PlanningFailure, 25 seconds of reserved execution and one request without usage. The evaluator retained only the exception type, so the underlying failure code is unconfirmed. No retry run was made after the 40-request cap.

No independent routing accuracy, calibrated confidence, statistically reliable latency or currency-cost benefit is established. Successful plans do not validate answer quality or clinical correctness.
